name: What information should I prepare before requesting a metal garage estimate?
description: Measure your build site, determine required building height and door dimensions, locate property setbacks, and clarify how you plan to use the building.

mainEntity.name: What information should I prepare before requesting a metal garage estimate?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before requesting an estimate, measure your available yard area and determine the intended use, such as parking vehicles, RV storage, or housing a workshop. Identify the vehicle clearances you need to establish door heights and roof clearance. Check your property boundary setbacks, utility lines, and HOA guidelines. Providing your contractor with a clear concept sketch and photos of the building pad helps them calculate accurate grading, concrete slab thickness, and framing requirements from the start.
